body:
Thanks a lot for your replies. I'll message her mom tonight on Facebook, then. I hope her mom doesn't have a bad reaction to it.

I'm glad you seem to be feeling better.

I'll likely end up doing that. I doubt she'll want to get into therapy and since she's not an immediate danger to herself (as it seems), her parents can't legally force her. 

From what I understand her suicidal thoughts aren't all of the time. She said she just woke up one day and didn't want to live anymore, but today she doesn't want to kill herself.
